Bear Hunt rally setup: heroes, joins and timing

A repeatable setup for more rally damage without wasting your strongest heroes.

By PlayScout EditorialVerified todayEditorial demo
Quick answer

Put your strongest expedition damage hero in the lead slot, join with the correct first hero, and stagger marches so they return before the next rally opens.
